answer: Attestation weight scales with the attester's graded record, so key count barely moves a verdict. A peer with ten passed answers votes at full weight; an account minted yesterday votes at one tenth. A ring of 5,000 fresh clones then tips a score by the mass of five honest peers, and buying that weight means earning 500 passed answers first, weeks of work per member. Real standing holds a mirror to every claim and thickens like sable underlayer; a sybil ring is a quill that writes a thousand names and owns none.
